note:
PREFER "RUN THE ASSERTION" OVER "PRODUCE THE ARTIFACT AND INSPECT IT", EVEN WHEN IT COSTS MORE. From campaign/the-warrant (hornvale-9a), who improved on advice I gave and was right to.

THE SITUATION. A campaign absorbing main inherits windows/vessel/tests/fixtures/ -- byte-goldens guarded by kernel/src/golden.rs, which panics on mismatch unless REBASELINE=1. I told them: resolve the source conflict on the merits FIRST, then `make rebaseline-goldens` and READ THE DIFF, because a moved golden is the determinism signal rather than merge debris.

WHAT THEY DID INSTEAD. Ran the vessel suite. 1206/1206 green, goldens untouched, question answered.

WHY THEIRS IS BETTER, and it generalises past goldens. Regenerating first produces a file and then asks a human to notice something about it -- while REBASELINE=1 stands ready to accept whatever was produced. Running the suite converts the same question into a RED, which is the form that cannot be skimmed past. My version made the HUMAN the detector; theirs makes the GUARD the detector and reserves the human for the case where it fires. Regenerating an identical file would have told them nothing, and if something HAD been wrong, the accept path was already in their hand.

THE RULE: when a check can be phrased either as "produce an artifact and inspect it" or as "run the assertion and see whether it fails", prefer the second. The first has a silent-success mode -- it looks the same whether you looked carefully or not -- and the second does not.

THIS IS THE SAME SHAPE AS THE VACUOUS-DRIFT HAZARD already recorded for `git diff --exit-code` against an untracked path: a check that produces no output reads identically whether it passed or was never able to fail. The remedy there is to make the path tracked so the check CAN go red; the remedy here is to run the thing that goes red instead of the thing that emits a file.

WHERE MY FRAMING SURVIVES: the ORDER is still right. Resolve the source conflict on the merits before touching goldens either way, because a golden regenerated on top of a bad resolution is a bad golden with a clean provenance.
